steps.what: EMStudioApp.run_command asks the page: request kind "command" with id and slots
PySession answers the request through the page's host.command(id, slots); false -> error py.noCommand
the page's host hook: command -> runScriptCommand(id, params)

runScriptCommand: the params checked against script-commands.json (refused in the page's words); an action runs its handler; a command with a script form runs it (no window when its values are given); otherwise runCommand(id)
runCommand: plugin:<id>/<cmd> -> plugin invocation; otherwise findRow(id) and click the row's button
findRow: only rows of kind "cmd" in MENUS (sub-menus walked)
